full_judgment: 3. At the trial the prosecution examined 12 witnesses as against none by the defence. The defence case is one of innocence and that accused persons are not in any way connected with the rape and murder of Morium. The further defence is that, a false case has been filed against the accused persons at the instance of the Chairman of the Union Parishad and member Nawab. On consideration of the evidence on record, the post-mortem report and confessional statements, the learned Special Tribunal found the accused-appellants guilty under section 7 of the Cruelty to Women (Deterrent Punishment) Ordinance, 1983 and passed the order of conviction and sentence as mentioned at the outset. By the same judgment the learned Special Tribunal acquitted co-accused Md. Hanif for lack of evidence against him. Aggrieved by this judgment and the order of conviction and sentence, the accused persons have preferred these two appeals.
